title: Test końcowy C1
intro: 20 pytań z całego poziomu C1. Zaliczenie od 80%.

items.prompt: Which request is the most tentative and polite?
options: I wonder if you could lend me your car.
I was wondering if you could lend me your car.
I am wondering if you could lend me your car.
items.explanation: Past Continuous (I was wondering) dodaje dystansu i uprzejmości – najdelikatniejsza forma prośby.

items.prompt: Complete the film summary in the tense usually used for plot summaries: “In the opening scene, a detective ___ a body in the park.”
items.explanation: Streszczenia fabuły piszemy w czasie teraźniejszym: Present Simple (finds).

items.prompt: The train ___ leave when I reached the platform.
items.explanation: Be about to oznacza „za chwilę”; w przeszłości: was about to leave (pociąg miał właśnie ruszyć).

items.source: It has been announced that the minister will visit Lagos next week.
items.explanation: Oficjalny plan w rejestrze formalnym: be to + bezokolicznik (is to visit); także is due to / is scheduled to.

items.text: So I'm walking down the street, and this guy suddenly {{1}} (come) up to me and {{2}} (start) shouting.
items.explanation: Narracja potoczna (anegdota) w czasie teraźniejszym: comes up, starts shouting – opowieść brzmi bardziej obrazowo.

items.prompt: Never before ___ so many people at the station.
items.explanation: Przysłówek o znaczeniu przeczącym na początku zdania wymaga inwersji: Never before have I seen…

items.source: As soon as she sat down, the lights went out.
answers: sooner had she sat down than
items.explanation: No sooner + inwersja (had she sat down) + than: dwie czynności następują tuż po sobie.

items.prompt: ___ I need right now is a good night's sleep.
items.explanation: Zdanie rozszczepione z what: What I need … is … (podkreślamy to, czego potrzebujemy).

items.text: It {{1}} John who broke the window, not Peter.
items.explanation: Zdanie rozszczepione o przeszłości: It was + wyróżniona osoba + who + czasownik.

items.prompt: ___ you need any help, please let me know.
items.explanation: Pierwszy okres warunkowy bez if: Should you need … (= If you should need …).

items.source: If I hadn't missed the bus, I wouldn't have been late.
items.after: missed the bus, I wouldn't have been late.
items.explanation: Trzeci okres warunkowy bez if: inwersja Had I not missed… (= If I hadn't missed…).

items.prompt: Not ___ what to do, she asked her teacher for advice.
items.explanation: Imiesłów czynny z przeczeniem: Not knowing what to do… (= Because she didn't know…).

items.text: {{1}} (live) in Spain for ten years, he speaks Spanish fluently.
items.explanation: Imiesłów perfekt oznacza czynność wcześniejszą od czasownika głównego: Having lived in Spain…

items.source: They introduced the new policy, and this caused a lot of confusion.
items.explanation: Nominalizacja: czasownik zamieniamy w rzeczownik (introduced → the introduction of …), typowe dla języka formalnego.

items.prompt:
A: I'd love to go to Rome.
B: So ___ I.
items.explanation: Elipsa po so: So + operator + podmiot. Operator musi pasować do zdania A (I'd love = I would).

items.prompt:
A: Are you coming to the party?
B: I hope ___.
items.explanation: Substytucja: so zastępuje całe zdanie (I hope so = I hope I'm coming). Przeczenie: I hope not.

items.prompt: He is believed ___ the country last week.
items.explanation: Strona bierna bezosobowa o przeszłości: is believed + to have + 3. forma.

items.prompt: You are writing to a university professor you have never met. Which opening is the MOST formal?
options: Dear Prof. Smith, I was hoping you could tell me about the course.
Hello Professor Smith, can you tell me about the course?
Hi Prof! Wanna ask about the course.
Dear Professor Smith, I am writing to enquire about the course.
items.explanation: Do nieznanego wykładowcy piszemy formalnie: Dear Professor …, I am writing to enquire…

items.prompt: Dopasuj potoczne wyrażenie do formalnego odpowiednika.
items.explanation: Rejestr formalny używa łacińskich czasowników: get in touch – contact, find out – ascertain, ask for – request, go up – increase. „Postpone” to formalny odpowiednik put off, którego nie ma po lewej.

items.prompt: Which sentence is the most cautious (hedged)?
options: It would seem that the results may be inaccurate.
items.explanation: Hedging łagodzi twierdzenie: It would seem that…, may be. Pozostałe zdania są kategoryczne.

items.prompt: It would seem ___ the economy is slowly recovering.
items.explanation: Po it would seem stoi that + zdanie (ostrożne sformułowanie tezy).

items.prompt: After spilling coffee on his laptop, your friend says: “Oh, brilliant. Just what I needed!” What does he mean?
options: He is relieved nothing was damaged.
He is annoyed and being ironic.
items.explanation: To ironia: pozytywne słowa wypowiedziane o nieprzyjemnej sytuacji oznaczają irytację.

items.source: Delikatnie mówiąc, to nie była dobra decyzja.
accepted: To put it mildly, it wasn't a good decision.
It wasn't a good decision, to put it mildly.
To put it mildly, that wasn't a good decision.
That wasn't a good decision, to put it mildly.
Putting it mildly, it wasn't a good decision.
Putting it mildly, that wasn't a good decision.
items.explanation: Understatement z wyrażeniem to put it mildly (delikatnie mówiąc).

items.prompt: During a presentation you don't understand a question from the audience. You say: ___
options: I'm afraid your question is unclear.
I'm sorry, could you rephrase that? I'm not sure I've followed.
items.explanation: Uprzejma prośba o doprecyzowanie pytania: could you rephrase that?

items.prompt:
A: How was the hotel?
B: Well, the beds were comfortable.
What does B imply?
options: The hotel wasn't very good overall.
items.explanation: Pochwała jednego drobnego elementu (tylko łóżka) sugeruje, że reszta była słaba – podtekst.

items.prompt: Which sentence is the best paraphrase of: “Despite initial doubts, the plan proved successful”?
options: The plan failed even though people doubted it.
People doubted the plan, so it was successful.
The plan was successful because of the doubts.
Although people were unsure at first, the plan worked well.
items.explanation: Parafraza zachowuje sens: despite initial doubts = although people were unsure at first; proved successful = worked well.

items.source: He said he would not support the proposal.
items.explanation: Parafraza czasownikiem: said he would not = refused to (refused to support).

items.prompt: The plan is expensive. ___, it could save us money in the long run.
items.explanation: Having said that wprowadza kontrast (mimo to). Pozostałe markery oznaczają przyczynę, dodanie albo skutek.

items.prompt: He's always ___ around the bush instead of saying what he really means.
items.explanation: Idiom: beat around the bush = mówić okrężnie, unikać sedna.

items.prompt: The company is facing a ___ shortage of skilled workers.
items.explanation: Kolokacja: a severe shortage (poważny niedobór). Strong, hard i heavy nie łączą się z shortage.
